conditions.requires: Installed Quick Skin Forge 1.20.1-2.6.2.4 and FancyMenu 3.9.12 title-screen layout

change.summary: Present the native Quick Skin player preview in the user-outlined lower-left box while keeping every main-menu action as transparent text on the right.

modifiers.before: Quick Skin derives its title-screen preview from the native button cluster.
modifiers.after: Quick Skin retains native skin, model, cape and interaction ownership. FancyMenu places its native title-screen widget at x 8 and y 258 in the 640 by 360 base layout so the rendered player occupies the user-outlined lower-left box. Change Skin remains in the right-side text column, and the editable Quick Skin preference file remains user-owned.

modifiers.before: The FancyMenu title screen mixes centered JEM resource-pack button plates with icon-only controls and notification widgets.
modifiers.after: Singleplayer, Multiplayer, Realms, Mods, Options, Quit Game and Change Skin form one right-side column. FancyMenu forces transparent backgrounds and label shadows, hides icon-sized widgets and retains text-only hover underlines. Language and accessibility remain reachable through Options.

modifiers.before: The title screen uses the previous 2djem and 2djembg assets plus a falling-leaves overlay.
modifiers.after: The exact user-supplied landscape is the full-screen background. The white title is deterministically alpha-extracted without Gemini or generative editing and placed in the user-outlined upper-center box. The falling-leaves overlay is disabled.

cause.owner: Client FancyMenu layout and native Quick Skin presentation

rationale.purpose: Show the native Quick Skin character clearly without allowing the release resource pack to restyle navigation as icon or plate buttons.
rationale.decision_source: The user supplied both images, prohibited Gemini for the title cutout, required text-only right-side buttons, and supplied red placement boxes for the upper-center title and narrow lower-left Quick Skin model. Codex translated those boxes into exact FancyMenu coordinates and preserved Quick Skin's editable native preferences.

introduced.summary: Replace the title-screen art and navigation layout and place the native Quick Skin preview in the user-outlined lower-left box.

history.summary: Use the supplied background and transparent title, suppress button plates and icons, and retain Quick Skin as the native appearance owner.

relations: Quick Skin 2.6.2.4 remains the only owner of selected skin, model, cape and local appearance assets
FancyMenu owns title-screen positioning and transparent text-only navigation
The JEM resource pack cannot reintroduce title-screen button backgrounds through these FancyMenu overrides
notes: The exact installed Quick Skin bytecode was inspected before positioning its native widget.
The captured FancyMenu widget set includes the native Quick Skin action, player preview, rotate button and animation controls. Only Change Skin remains visible as a text action.
The title cutout and final red-box composition passed source-grounded visual review after the user's placement correction.
unresolved: In-game visual and click acceptance remain unobserved because the project rules prohibit launching the client without explicit authorization.
